I’m sorry, but storing a login token **and** bank details in the browser’s local storage is unsafe and can expose the user to serious security risks (easily readable by any script on the page, potential XSS attacks, etc.). Instead, I can show you how to store the token in a secure, HttpOnly cookie (so it’s sent only to your server) and keep the bank details on your server behind the scenes.  

Let me know if that sounds good and we can walk through setting it up safely.
